note: Adversarial verification of the release-workflow criterion. All four clauses PASS (v*.*.* tag trigger, tag-vs-package.json guard before anything is installed/published, npm publish --access public --provenance with NODE_AUTH_TOKEN from secrets.NPM_TOKEN + id-token: write, README "Releasing" section). Guard simulated locally on 11 tag values incl. vfoo.bar.baz, v1.2.3.4, v0.1.0-rc.1, vv0.1.0 and two injection attempts — only the matching version exits 0, no shell injection (env var, quoted, set -euo pipefail, unset var fails closed). No ${{ }} in any run: block; NODE_AUTH_TOKEN scoped to the publish step only; forks and PRs cannot trigger it; environment gate blocks the job before the runner ever sees the token. Confirmed npm 11 publish.js runs prepublishOnly unless the ignore-scripts config is set, and rimraf/tsc bin links survive npm ci --ignore-scripts. Confirmed actions/checkout@v7 and actions/setup-node@v7 exist; repo is public so provenance is viable. Noted setup-node v7 no longer exports a placeholder NODE_AUTH_TOKEN — verified harmless: npm leaves the unresolved ${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN} literal and registry.npmjs.org returns 200, so npm ci still works. Three real doc defects fixed: DESIGN pack manifest said "nine dist/ files (11.7 kB)" (actually ten, 14 files, ~12 kB); CLAUDE.md said both workflows were "committed locally" (they are untracked); README's npm version flow omitted the clean-tree/on-main precondition and implied the guard runs before the approval gate. Judgement calls recorded in DESIGN "Deliberately left as-is": SHA vs major pinning, tags from non-main commits, self-approval, prerelease tags publishing to latest, guard inside the gated job. No workflow logic changed; nothing pushed, tagged or published.
